comments: Searches entity grants with the specified criteria and pagination.

params.name: entityId
comments: (Optional) The entity Id to search for grants on.

params.name: name
comments: (Optional) The name of the entity grant to search for. Supports wildcard search using *.

params.name: userId
comments: (Optional) The user Id to search for grants on.

params.name: numberOfResults
comments: (Optional) The number of results to return. Defaults to 25.

params.name: orderBy
comments: (Optional) The field to order the results by.

params.name: startRow
comments: (Optional) The offset into the total results. Defaults to 0.
